preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'VK?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of 'V', 'K', and '?' characters.
The sum of lengths of all test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of possible periods followed by the periods in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p in periods)
postconditions.description: All possible periods must be between 1 and the length of the string n.
There must be at least one possible period for the string.
